title: Lights do not dim when light and rheostat S/W turned ON

content.caption: Section and Trouble
rows: Speedometer | Lights do not dim when light and rheostat S/W turned ON.

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for troubleshooting speedometer dimming issue

steps.text: With the ignition S/W at ON position, check that there is battery voltage between terminals 7 and 9 of sub-harness (SST) when rheostat turned ON.
Does speedometer dim when other meters are disconnected?
With the light S/W and rheostat turned ON, is there battery voltage on TC terminal of rheostat?
steps.yes: Bad wiring between rheostat and meter

steps.text: Connect other meters one by one to find bad meter.
